hook: College football's oldest rivalry trophy was born 13 years before Arizona statehood.

sections.voiceover: College football's oldest rivalry trophy was born 13 years before Arizona statehood.
b_roll: Historic vintage photograph of early football equipment from 1899
Map graphic highlighting Arizona territorial boundaries prior to 1912

sections.voiceover: On November 30, 1899, Arizona Normal School played the University of Arizona. They claimed the original Territorial Cup after a 3-game season. Who would win the 100th game in Tucson?
b_roll: Diagram showing 1899 Arizona Football League match schedule
Historic photograph of Tucson gridiron field in 1899

sections.voiceover: However, the NCAA recognizes the Territorial Cup as college football's oldest rivalry trophy game.
b_roll: Graphic display of NCAA official recognition mark
Motion graphic timeline of college football trophy origins

sections.voiceover: The Arizona Territorial Football League created this historic gridiron battle. The 2026 meeting marked their 100th Territorial Cup game.
b_roll: Diagram mapping Arizona State University versus University of Arizona head-to-head history
Graphic counter accumulating games from 1 to 100

sections.voiceover: That 1899 trophy remains college football's oldest rivalry tradition.
b_roll: Historic photograph of the original Territorial Cup
